correctness.rationale: The unsigned incidence factorization gives all eigenspaces and proves the m-n lower bound. Invertibility of a square signless incidence submatrix is equivalent to spanning odd-unicyclic components. Explicit cut bounds force selected edges to be connected nonbipartite or leave only one isolated vertex; maximum-cut equality cases are handled separately. The exceptional K_{2,2,2} case is proved algebraically, then all 924 six-edge complements are checked by exact rational PBH ranks. Cauchy-Binet proves the corrected weighted census. Existence follows from a spanning triangle with tree attachments.

Pang’s line-graph language is not an equivalent control system.

value.rationale: A natural coordinate-actuation task on edge-state networks is solved for an infinite high-symmetry regular family, beyond the maximum-eigenmultiplicity input count. The theorem identifies all optimal supports by a graph-pseudoforest structure, isolates four genuinely uncontrollable minimum candidates in the smallest three-part instance, and gives a natural exact weighted census and a nontrivial ordinary count of 496.
